title: Fidelity Regret: Measuring Simulator Misspecification in Verifiable Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.22263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RLVF assumes the verifier evaluates the quantity of interest. In genetic-circuit design, a topological verifier can establish that a program is a valid circuit computing the target function, whereas ranking its physical performance requires a simulator. We measure fidelity regret, the reference simple regret incurred when a cheap simulator selects the design, over a 21,362-design combination subspace spanning 5 measured gate libraries and 3 organisms. Exact ordered-assignment checks retain positive regret in every tested cell while shifting magnitudes in both directions. Mean normalized regret is 0.369 over 72 cells and only 6 have zero regret. The discrepancy depends strongly on the reference axis: the yeast library SC1C1G1T1 has mean regret 0.113 for cytometry quality and 0.801 for growth burden, and every evaluated library--circuit-size pair has positive burden regret. translated_title: 保真度遗憾：在可验证设计中度量模拟器的误设
translated_abstract: RLVF（基于可验证反馈的强化学习）假设验证器评估的正是所关心的目标量。在基因电路设计中，拓扑验证器可以确认某个程序是计算目标函数的有效电路，但对其物理性能进行排序则需要依赖模拟器。我们测量了“保真度遗憾”（fidelity regret），即当使用廉价的模拟器来选择设计时所产生的参考简单遗憾，实验覆盖了一个包含21,362个设计组合的子空间，涉及5个经过实测的门文库和3种生物体。精确的有序分配检查在每个测试单元中都保持正遗憾，同时其幅度在两个方向上均有变化。72个单元的平均归一化遗憾为0.369，其中仅有6个单元的遗憾为零。这种偏差强烈依赖于参考轴：酵母文库SC1C1G1T1在流式细胞测量质量方面的平均遗憾为0.113，而在生长负担方面的平均遗憾为0.801，且每一个被评估的“文库—电路规模”组合都具有正的负担遗憾。拓扑验证将所有有效的门分配等同视之，而
tldr: 本文提出“保真度遗憾”指标来量化基因电路设计中廉价模拟器与真实性能之间的偏差，发现模拟器选择的设计在几乎所有测试单元中都产生正遗憾（平均归一化遗憾为0.369，仅6个单元为零），且偏差大小强烈依赖于所评估的性能指标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "fidelity regret" to quantify simulator misspecification in genetic-circuit design, showing that simulator-selected designs incur positive regret in nearly all tested settings (mean normalized regret 0.369 across 72 cells, with only 6 at zero), and that the magnitude of this discrepancy depends strongly on which performance metric is referenced.
